text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The urine findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant pyuria, hematuria, nitrites, leukocyte esterase, and bacteriuria. Escherichia coli (>100,000 CFU/mL) is identified as the causative organism. The presence of glucose in urine and low specific gravity may warrant further evaluation. No casts or ketones detected. Clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
